release_model.laboratory_purpose: prove complete-chain integrity, fail-closed delivery and evolution boundaries before production
release_model.production_purpose: validate real mixed-format extraction accuracy, review latency, end-to-end speed and sanitized self-evolution observations
release_model.rule: Laboratory validates chain integrity; production validates real effectiveness. Production observations do not self-promote Skill changes.

primary_critical_paths.candidate_action: Build one manifest after archive PASS, dispatch independent sources in the same ready wave, consume results on arrival, join coverage/conflicts once, reuse evidence_pack downstream, and split one large source only after a structural index permits locator-bounded reads without duplicate full-source decode.
primary_critical_paths.accuracy_boundary: No speedup may reduce source coverage, formula/table structure, locator fidelity, conflict preservation, source fingerprint binding, or explicit unread/unverified reporting. PDF content extraction is not mechanically claimed by the repository laboratory fixture.

primary_critical_paths.candidate_action: Prepare reviewer ready-set before freeze, launch ready independent reviewers in the same scheduling decision after immutable hashes exist, consume structured results on arrival, use artifact-scoped evidence plus one full/cross-artifact consistency review, and invalidate only changed/dependent scopes.
primary_critical_paths.quality_boundary: T4-T6 requires at least one independent reviewer per required artifact; T7+ requires at least two distinct reviewers per required artifact. Multi-artifact delivery additionally requires a valid full/cross-artifact consistency review.

implemented_changes: T0 builds a minimal dependency DAG and same-wave ready-set for independent positive-benefit work.
Source archive PASS leads to one source manifest with stable identity/fingerprint/locator and expected coverage.
Independent source extraction dispatches in the same wave and completed results can release downstream dependencies on arrival.
Large single files are not blindly fanned out; intra-file parallelism requires structural indexing and locator-bounded reads.
Source extraction is reused through evidence_pack and unreasoned duplicate full-source rereads are disallowed.
Agent Result carries source fingerprints and optional dispatch timing fields.
Reviewer ready-set can be prepared before candidate freeze but verdict work starts only on immutable candidate hashes.
Ready reviewers launch in the same scheduling decision and return structured completion feedback directly.
Delivery Gate supports legacy full review plus artifact-scoped and cross-artifact review evidence.
Every required artifact independently meets the original review-strength requirement; scoped review cannot weaken coverage.
One-artifact rework can preserve unrelated unchanged artifact review evidence while refreshing the changed scope and cross-artifact consistency review.
Routine non-light fixed control loading is reduced from four modules to Router-only with conditional loading for the rest.
Independent final artifacts use one writer per artifact/path after a stable shared fact baseline.
Independent nontrivial DOCX/XLSX mechanical inspections can use process-parallel checks only when expected net benefit is positive; infrastructure failure falls back to identical serial checks.
Simple tasks remain single-executor and quality/delivery/evolution gates remain fail-closed.

A T10 laboratory integration test now chains classification, source protection, evidence contract, Office outputs, T10 review strength, Delivery Gate, production observation recording without self-promotion, and stage-stop behavior.

laboratory_t10_validation.environment: GitHub-hosted macOS 14 ARM64 with canonical /Users/macbook/ChatGPT validation paths
chain: four-source byte-identical archive gate for TXT/DOCX/XLSX/PDF
DOCX and XLSX final artifact creation
two independent-review slots per required artifact at T10
sanitized serial-wait production observation recorded with EVO=null
stage_complete stops current execution and requires reclassification for next stage
limitations: The PDF fixture proves source preservation and explicit unread coverage only; repository laboratory tooling does not claim PDF text-extraction accuracy.
Review identities in the T10 fixture are mechanical test identities; they validate gate semantics and do not satisfy the two real independent candidate reviews required for stable promotion.

performance_iterations.workload: 6 separate runs of 8 independent synthetic DOCX inspections with 24000 paragraphs each
performance_iterations.interpretation: Component-level synthetic evidence only; production validates real end-to-end effect.
Unchanged artifact review evidence can survive unrelated artifact rework while changed and cross-artifact scopes are refreshed; production validates real review-time savings.

hosted_macos_module_diagnostic.known_runtime_issue: The lifecycle transaction case can fail inside the full test_evolution_loop module on GitHub-hosted macOS because maintenance sandbox initialization is denied in that accumulated process state; the identical lifecycle case passes in a fresh process in the same validation run.

production_validation_targets: Real mixed-format TXT/Word/Excel/PDF source-ingestion accuracy, coverage and wall-clock.
Real review dispatch delay, slowest required-reviewer tail, join delay and completion-feedback delay.
Real QV-03/QV-06-shaped end-to-end wall-clock and the directional 10-to-7-minute objective.
Sanitized production incidents for serial-wait, duplicate-read, duplicate-check, false-completion, quality regression and other registered failure types.
No new version is justified solely by time passage; v1.5.4 remains the production baseline unless material production evidence supports another candidate.
pre_finalization_remaining: Two real independent candidate reviews on the final immutable candidate, as required by the existing evolution policy.
Fresh current-candidate user finalization approval after the final immutable SHA is reported.
